objective: Eliminate late first binding of old WorkflowRun exit sources and expose run incarnation on every public exit callback.
required_change: Remove the WorkflowObservationBinding API that asks admission to issue its first token at an arbitrary later bind call. A binding must only accept a source token that the coordinator already issued atomically at authoritative run activation.

Add an explicit admission/scheduler state-writer operation that atomically activates the ActiveRunRef and registers the exact WorkflowRun source object, returning an ExitSourceToken for that incarnation. This is the only external-source issuance path. Repeated/idempotent activation must not silently rebind a different or previously retired source.

WorkflowObservationBinding may expose a pure persisted-identity resolver before activation. Its final attach/bind step must require the pre-issued token, verify owner/source/run/incarnation, and never issue or refresh a token itself. Delayed use of an old token after A->None->same A must fail.

Update production probe composition to resolve identity, atomically activate/register the WorkflowRun source, then construct the bound binding before collection. No unbound collection or implicit current-incarnation bind fallback.

Include `run_incarnation` from the validated token/key in every public on_exit event, including pending retry after callback failure. Preserve it unchanged across retry so UI consumers can reject old-incarnation updates.
Add tests for attach-old/delay-first-bind after replacement, activation with old/foreign/retired source, delayed old token, public retry incarnation, and correct new source activation/exit.
verification: Rerun actual OMP 18.2.10 using explicit source activation and bound binding.
constraints: apply_patch only; no workflow records, uv/local env/package artifacts, destructive git actions, or graphify restore.
